Name: onset
Description: When the current problem began, or how it began (sudden or gradual).

Name: duration
Description: How long the problem has lasted, or how long each episode lasts.

Name: character
Description: Quality or nature of the main symptom (e.g. sharp, dull, productive cough, watery stool).

Name: location
Description: Where on the body the symptom is, including radiation.

Name: severity
Description: How bad the symptom is (scale, functional impact, progression).

Name: timing
Description: Pattern or frequency (constant, intermittent, nocturnal, after meals).

Name: aggravating_relieving
Description: Anything that makes it worse or better, including treatments tried.

Name: associated_symptoms
Description: Other symptoms occurring with the main complaint.

Name: chronic_conditions
Description: Known chronic diseases or diagnoses (diabetes, HIV, hypertension, etc.).

Name: prior_episodes
Description: Previous episodes of a similar problem, prior hospitalizations, or pregnancies.

Name: surgeries
Description: Past surgeries or procedures.

Name: current_meds
Description: Medications, supplements, or contraception currently taken.

Name: recent_changes
Description: Medications recently started, stopped, or changed, or recent vaccinations.

Name: allergies
Description: Drug or other allergies and the reaction type, or explicit 'no known allergies'.

Name: smoking
Description: Tobacco use, amount, duration.

Name: alcohol
Description: Alcohol use and amount.

Name: drugs
Description: Recreational or illicit drug use, including IV drug use.

Name: occupation
Description: Job, occupational exposures, or living situation.

Name: travel
Description: Recent travel, camping, animal or environmental exposures.

Name: sexual_history
Description: Sexual activity, partners, protection, STI history.

Name: family_history
Description: Diseases in relatives, with age of onset when given.

Name: ros_positives
Description: Symptoms present in other organ systems not already captured in HPI (e.g. fever, weight loss).

Name: ros_negatives
Description: Symptoms explicitly denied (pertinent negatives).

Name: vitals
Description: Temperature, blood pressure, pulse, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, BMI.

Name: exam_findings
Description: Physical examination findings.

Name: lab_results
Description: Laboratory, imaging, pathology, ECG, or other test results.
